title:
FOUR KNOTS
RUN THE BOAT.
scriptLine: Tie it till your hands know it.

hero.prompt: A close view of a white dock cleat on the bow of a white runabout with a dock line tied around it, a wooden dock beside it, aqua water and desert mountains behind.

meaning.label: WHAT IT MEANS
meaning.text: Each knot has one job. Dock, loop, fender, piling. Four knots cover almost every line you'll touch.

items.label: Cleat hitch: wrap the base, cross the horns, lock it. No extra wraps
Bowline: a fixed loop that won't slip and still unties
Clove hitch: fenders on a rail. Quick, adjustable, temporary
Round turn, two half hitches: pilings and rings. The one that holds

cta: Get on the list. Link in bio.
